thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall — sustained memory pressure on inference cluster in us-west-2. High RPM from model family corsair-7b; pods showing repeated OOMs and evictions. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/corsair-7b. Root ts 2739012345

margo: seeing the alert. Is this hitting customer traffic or just internal load tests?

nate: hitting production. Two paying customers showing 5xx spikes and slower token generation. Error rate on corsair routes up 4.8% -> 12% over last 10m.

anika: if pods are OOMing we need to reduce in-flight tokens. Suggest surgical RPM trim for corsair-7b and enable per-request batching cap. Can we lower RPM by ~40% immediately and monitor?

reza: agree. We should do a canary first: apply to 10% of traffic, wait 60s, then widen. Command to run via ops-cli: 
```
# reduce RPM for corsair-7b for 20m, canary 10%
ops-cli quota adjust --model corsair-7b --rpm 1800 --tpm 72000 --duration 20m --canary 0.1 --reason "OOM mitigation"
```

sam: note: two enterprise customers on corsair have strict latency SLA. We should exempt them from the canary if possible and instead route them to corsair-lite-3b fallback to avoid 500s.

margo: good call. Nate, can you confirm customer IDs? We should also post a quick status to #support so CS is aware.

nate: customer IDs: CUST-2031, CUST-4210. I'll open a ticket and ping support. Posting there now.

anika: after canary, if eviction rate drops we widen to 50% then 100%. Also temporarily disable streaming to reduce long-lived connections — do we have a quick flag?

reza: yes. runtime toggle: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate/corsair-7b","streaming":false}
```
Apply via runtime-config: 
```
ops-cli runtime patch --route /v1/generate/corsair-7b --payload @payload.json --reason "disable streaming during OOM spike"
```

sam: that will impact apps relying on streaming. We must call it out in the support post.

margo: ok executing plan. Step 1 canary RPM trim (10%), step 2 disable streaming on canary group, step 3 monitor for 5m and widen. Reza, can you run the ops-cli command?

reza: running now. Output: 
```
Started quota change job: job-id=job-9f3c
Applied canary to 10% of traffic
```

margo: noticed error-rate on canary is already lower. pods show fewer OOMs. Eviction count down 70% in canary group.

nate: opening incident ticket INC-2026 and linking dashboards, customer impact, runbook. Brief: corsair-7b RPM spike causing OOMs -> apply canary rpm trim -> disable streaming.

sam: support notified. Ticket: CS-9987. Customers flagged and told we are mitigating; ETA 20m for stabilization.

dan (ops-bot): scheduled job job-9f3c -> will auto-widen after 5m if metrics stable.

margo: widening now to 50% as eviction rate stable across canary for 6m. Reza, widen command?

reza: widened. ops-cli output: job-9f3c -> scaled canary to 50%.

margo: hitting 0.9% errors now on corsair routes. Token throughput back to normal for most clients.

sam: for the exempted enterprise customers we routed to fallback model corsair-lite-3b. No 500s reported from them.

diego: taking handoff in 20m for oncall. Summary for next oncall: 1) Applied a 40% RPM reduction to corsair-7b via canary job-9f3c, rolled to 50% then 100% if stable. 2) Disabled streaming on corsair-7b routes during mitigation. 3) Exempted CUST-2031 and CUST-4210 and routed them to corsair-lite-3b. 4) Incident ticket INC-2026 and CS ticket CS-9987 open.

margo: adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/surgeon-rpm-sculpt. Also attaching CLI logs to the incident.

diego: I'll monitor for next 30m and then start gradual revert if stable. Marking this thread for postmortem if errors re-appear.

margo: thanks team. Will follow up with postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
